cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.
